arStrings.szText: "Peace. The Oracle sent us. We are here for a Trial of Sight."
There is no Trial of Sight anymore. Your corrupted sisters stormed this sacred ground and butchered our young seers. The youngest was eight! Eight! Her blood still stains this floor!
Voice breaking with fury and grief. Emphasis on the repetition of “Eight!”
Your young will be avenged, I--
Shocked, but trying to be diplomatic. Cut off.
You were the right hand of the Queen. As far as I’m concerned, you share her blame.
You want a damned Trial of Sight, hm? Hunt your corrupted, tear their eyes from their skulls, and lay them at my feet. That will be your trial.
Seething. Practically spitting contempt. Each clause clipped and punctuated
